verdict.rationale: Independent reviews (TechPowerup, Tom's Hardware) note the 9950X3D is 'energy efficient' with strong productivity/application performance and describe architectural changes (inverted CCD/L3D stacking) that improve thermal dissipation versus prior X3D chips, implying better sustained behavior under load. However, there is no dedicated sustained-render/export throttling test, no documented power envelope (TDP/PPT) figures, and no long-duration workload power-per-watt benchmark specific to creator export scenarios. Missing for 10: explicit power envelope specs (PPT/TDP), independent sustained multi-minute render throttling/power draw charts, and creator-workload-specific efficiency benchmarks.
